artifact: AUD-030 static MnemoCode browser parity matrix
execution: None: source inspection only; no inventory harness, application, test, browser, build, renderer or formatter was executed.
acceptance: All 60 obligations are mapped; no confirmed source omission remains after the two scoped fixes. This is static reachability plus the named parent fixtures, not complete real-browser or release acceptance.
reconciliation: All 60 rows were drafted before a source reread. Parent-reported fixes are credited only where the corresponding handler/owner is present; in-progress edits retain their inspected state. No runtime or generated-artifact acceptance is implied.
ownership: Only parity-matrix.json and parity-matrix.md in this harness directory. Product changes, execution scheduling, sibling communication and the AUD-030 report remain with the parent.

upstream.latestParentPinStatus: Parent sync and offline binding passed against the frozen final-05 owner snapshot; all 175 mapped files match. The older suppliedCoordinatorSourceFingerprint remains historical.
upstream.identityCaveat: The fingerprint is supplied by the sibling notes, not a fingerprint of these inspected browser bytes. Concurrent edits and vendored-source equality require the parent's final reconciliation.

scope.rows: Every upstream obligation P01 through P60, including public-library obligations without a standalone CLI command.
scope.browser: Wallet Deriver MnemoCode operations; Scanner candidate-list import for P32/P34/P59.
scope.editionRule: Controls require mnemocode; shares also require sskr; document exports require mnemocode-cards. Bitcoin evidence requires Bitcoin admission. Dash Community offers fingerprint and Dash address evidence; other selective builds offer their admitted coins. An omitted feature does not establish parity for a build that includes it.
scope.lineReferenceRule: sources keys resolve to workspace-relative paths; a reference key:line identifies a one-based source line at inspection. Named calls disambiguate references after formatting. No absolute machine-owner path is published.
scope.stateRule: States describe static semantic reachability, not test success. Every row still needs runtime validation. A visible tab, API export, generic download or successful neighboring workflow is insufficient.

stateDefinitions.covered: A reachable control-to-owner chain implements the stated operation within the shared supported domain; runtime behavior is unexecuted.
stateDefinitions.source-gap: An inspected handler or adapter omits an applicable semantic, option, output or refusal; the row explains the partial path and missing part.
stateDefinitions.shared-unsupported: Both upstream and browser owners reject the same requested operation; the refusal is not a browser implementation gap.
stateDefinitions.host-equivalent: The browser implements an explicit host adaptation, such as worker termination, download/ZIP delivery or contextual help, while retaining the underlying operation.
stateDefinitions.pending-validation: The available source trace is insufficient to claim complete coverage; the unresolved acceptance question is explicit.

parentHandoff.rowCompleteness: P01 through P60 are enumerated exactly once, confirmed by read-only row inspection. Enumeration does not mean all obligations are complete or accepted; no parser, application or test execution.

resolvedShareChallenge.meaning: The share controls and complete limits chain are now present. CLI filters command arguments accepted by restore; browser routing instead opens Restore for explicit settings before running. No reachable trace of a configured applicable share allowance being silently lost was established.
resolvedShareChallenge.consentBoundary: Decode's code allowance belongs to its marked-code block, which input/kind changes hide. FirstShare carries text/fromQr only, not code-job consent. Restore has its own MnemoCodeWorkerJob; its input event revises confirmation, and captured limits belong to that share request. A confirmed code job must not authorize share work.
resolvedShareChallenge.runtimeStatus: Source reconciliation only; routing, allowance edits and fresh share consent still need queued browser checks.

remainingChallenges.meaning: Startup/full-test composition is present, but real-browser failure-before-secret activation, selected-edition pruning and browser host services remain unexecuted. Node behavior or success cannot establish browser acceptance.

parentHandoff.scopeBoundary: Only P01-P60 semantics in the upstream notes are mapped. An unused library function, tab or generic export does not automatically establish coverage or a new gap. Shared capability refusals remain explicit.

cliOptionPolicy: A row's cliOptions and optionGroups identify pertinent accepted options, not new flags. The current commandOptions registry, its imported groups and command-specific refusals govern complete accepted sets. --dates/--old-dates normalize to date/old-date; accepted singular --date/--old-date do not gain plural multi-value consumption. Numeric --format aliases follow the upstream representation order; share commands use transport names. JSON representation is a library API, not a CLI format number.
walletControlRule: Wallet rows list actual Forgotten instance IDs. The same suffixes are expanded for the other listed instances by the shared partial and MnemoCodeWalletTemplate; visibility and coin/edition admission are controlled by WalletEvidenceField. Decode wallet controls belong to marked-code recovery, not every complete-code decode.

rows.cliSemantics: Reversibly encode/decode English BIP39 indexes as English words, word numbers, Unicode, RGB or Color Unicode without changing the original phrase in Direct mode.
rows.browserRoute: Encode/Decode operation buttons invoke their handlers after the recovery readiness gate; each format selector selects the shared representation.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared phrase/index/form validation; malformed or ambiguous input is shown as an error and requires a representation choice.
rows.progressMapping: Synchronous bounded conversion; no search progress.
rows.cancelMapping: No long conversion job; Decode result actions are bound to InputRevision.
rows.outputMapping: Concealed payload, MNC1 Save record, mode/form facts, palette and original/encoded fingerprints; decoded phrase has explicit Copy/Use actions.
rows.pendingValidation: Exact published representation answers in every admitted format and length, with malformed input refusal; no execution here.

rows.cliSemantics: Apply and undo checksum-preserving MnemoCode Seedshift; dates are independent recovery inputs and are excluded from the saved backup.
rows.browserRoute: DatesField reads the chosen mode's dates; Decode uses the record's mode before deciding which dates apply.
rows.refusalMapping: Masking.assertDateCount and calendar parsing reject invalid counts/dates; decoding warns that checksum-valid output does not identify the wallet.
rows.progressMapping: Bounded synchronous shift/unshift.
rows.cancelMapping: Input changes invalidate Decode publication; no long shift to cancel.
rows.outputMapping: MNC1 record excludes dates; original and encoded fingerprints are distinguished; unverified decoded wallet warning remains visible.
rows.pendingValidation: Known Seedshift output, order/count rules, wrong-date warning and exact recovery with original dates.

rows.cliSemantics: Original Seedshift shifts the complete final word without replacing it; report possible encoded or restored checksum failure.
rows.browserRoute: The legacy selector maps to the ordinary legacy owner; the valid-final-word alternative is a separate mode.
rows.refusalMapping: Invalid input dates/phrase are refused; an invalid restored checksum is shown without a trusted phrase handoff.
rows.progressMapping: Synchronous conversion; legacy candidate fingerprints are asynchronous only for the replacement variant.
rows.cancelMapping: Decode input revision suppresses stale fingerprint results and actions.
rows.outputMapping: Encoded checksum warning, optional replacement explanation, decoded validity and shorter-prefix fingerprint hints.
rows.pendingValidation: Published legacy vector, unchanged final-word shift and checksum-failure presentation.

rows.cliSemantics: Optionally replace a legacy shifted final word with a checksum-valid word; record the actual resulting mode and decode all possible original final words.
rows.browserRoute: The seedshift-legacy-valid selector is the host translation of the CLI flag; the adapter asks legacy encode with validLastWord and returns backup.mode.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared encodability/date/phrase refusals; UI explains information loss and the need for independent wallet evidence.
rows.progressMapping: Replacement is bounded; candidate fingerprints are computed asynchronously without a progress counter.
rows.cancelMapping: InputRevision guards candidate fingerprint completion and every retained Copy action; no separate candidate-fingerprint Cancel button.
rows.outputMapping: Actual MNC1 mode, candidate phrase/fingerprint table, fingerprint lookup and concealed candidate copying; no automatic claim of original-wallet identification.
rows.pendingValidation: Changed and already-valid last-word cases, exact candidate families and action revocation during fingerprint computation.

rows.cliSemantics: Validate supported English BIP39 lengths, words and checksum plus mode-specific rules; checksum success must not be presented as proof of the intended wallet.
rows.browserRoute: Encode reads through the source owner and assertValidMnemonic; Decode/word/date paths ask the vendored owners, and word-count selects read the shared count list.
rows.refusalMapping: Unsupported word counts, words, checksum and mode/date combinations are refused or shown as invalid readings; Seedshift and candidate-result wallet warnings remain explicit.
rows.progressMapping: Immediate input diagnostics; long recovery uses its own job progress.
rows.cancelMapping: Inherited from the selected conversion or search workflow.
rows.outputMapping: Seed diagnostic, validity messages, original fingerprint and wallet-recognition warning rather than checksum-only confirmation.
rows.pendingValidation: Every shared length, wrong-word/checksum refusals and warning persistence in each supported mode.

rows.cliSemantics: Detect fitting representations, ask on ambiguity, preserve joined/apart Unicode and color elements and refuse invalid syntax; numeric format aliases identify the same forms.
rows.browserRoute: Auto-detect uses BackupReading.formats; ambiguity requires the explicit form selector. Marked-code ambiguity is checked separately before recovery ways are offered.
rows.refusalMapping: Ambiguous forms are named and no representation is silently selected; shared element parsers reject malformed syntax.
rows.progressMapping: Synchronous reading and classification; recovery has its own progress.
rows.cancelMapping: Input revisions invalidate Decode results.
rows.outputMapping: Form facts and joined/apart concealed code displays; browser selects named formats with the CLI's numbered help labels.
rows.pendingValidation: Ambiguous complete/marked forms, joined Unicode and Color Unicode, invalid element framing and numeric alias correspondence.

rows.cliSemantics: Read/write MNC1 with record mode/form overriding host hints and conflict guidance; separately expose the library's JSON representation output without inventing a CLI format.
rows.browserRoute: Save record and Save JSON with dates and shifts are generated concealed-result actions without fixed IDs; Decode imports text and reports that the header overrides both selectors.
rows.refusalMapping: Malformed header is refused; record ownership is explained. The general note is not a separate detailed modeConflict/formatConflict rendering.
rows.progressMapping: Text file admission is asynchronous; record conversion is synchronous.
rows.cancelMapping: Decode result revision follows imported input; the text-file helper owns stale reads.
rows.outputMapping: MNC1 text record excludes dates; the separate mnemocode-representation.json uses the shared JSON representation and explicitly warns that it includes every representation, dates and shifts and must stay private.
rows.pendingValidation: Conflicting selectors versus record header, malformed header, exact MNC1/JSON output and concealed JSON-button gating with the explicit dates warning.

rows.cliSemantics: Admit typed, text-file and applicable local PNG QR inputs; interactive secret acquisition excludes simultaneous secret arguments and refusals must not echo secret text.
rows.browserRoute: Encode, Forgotten words/date codes, Decode and Re-encode now install generated local file/QR buttons via installFieldImports; generated buttons have labels, not stable IDs. The imported content feeds the corresponding typed/linked input owner.
rows.refusalMapping: Bounded input/admission rules and owner messages; browser has no CLI secret-argument channel. Error-text privacy is still an unexecuted negative acceptance check.
rows.progressMapping: Import status or owner errors; no secret-processing progress before admission.
rows.cancelMapping: Import helpers and input revision own replacement/clear; search cancellation starts only after a request is admitted.
rows.outputMapping: Admitted local text feeds the same input owner; no remote resource or automatic upload.
rows.pendingValidation: Oversized/malformed local text and PNG, imported marked phrases, replacement races, secret-free refusals and browser acquisition without CLI secret-argument channels.

rows.cliSemantics: Apply declared phrase length before representation detection and marked-code parsing; preserve real question marks and drop only trailing card decoys.
rows.browserRoute: All three readers pass chosenPhraseWords into readMnemoCodeBackup; marked-code requests retain words across the worker boundary.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared word-count and retained-code syntax refusals; auto-detection uses only each form's admitted prefix. Share classification remains a separate Decode decision.
rows.progressMapping: Reading is bounded; any marked/date search reports its own total.
rows.cancelMapping: Words selector is watched by Decode/Recovery input ownership; marked worker results are dropped after edits.
rows.outputMapping: Recovered phrase/code prefix and original length, without interpreting decoys as forgotten real elements.
rows.pendingValidation: Declared length plus joined/partial marks and malformed trailing decoys in every form; challenge Decode's earlier share-versus-codes classification independently.

rows.cliSemantics: Route marked encoded elements to code recovery and phrase words to word recovery; hints and classification must not silently change representation.
rows.browserRoute: Decode offers MnemoCodeMissingCodes; Forgotten code selection opens Decode; word recovery refuses encoded-code input and points to Decode.
rows.refusalMapping: Words-versus-codes guidance is explicit; ambiguity requires the user's form/kind answer.
rows.progressMapping: Classification/hints are immediate; the selected recovery owns subsequent progress.
rows.cancelMapping: Classification changes revise the relevant job; hints do not start searches.
rows.outputMapping: A corrected route and explanation, preserving input until the user starts the right operation.
rows.pendingValidation: Marked English versus encoded forms, ambiguous code/share text and hint behavior without silent conversion.

rows.cliSemantics: Recover unread English, number, Unicode, RGB and Color Unicode elements with full-element or partial marks and unambiguous joined syntax.
rows.browserRoute: Decode offers marked-format choices and builds MissingCodes with the declared length and mode; the search worker rebuilds the same typed-code owner.
rows.refusalMapping: Ambiguous marked forms require selection; malformed marks and excessive solution spaces are refused by shared parsers/limits.
rows.progressMapping: mnemocode-decode-missing-status reports checked/total/found and elapsed time.
rows.cancelMapping: Missing-stop terminates the worker; edits revoke the request and stale result publication.
rows.outputMapping: Found whole codes and filled positions, or a bounded unverified candidate table, with correction guidance.
rows.pendingValidation: Every marked representation, whole/partial elements and joined syntax with exact accepted and refused examples.

rows.cliSemantics: Choose an encoded-fingerprint filter, wallet comparison, or explicitly bounded unverified candidate listing; wallet evidence and list-candidates are exclusive.
rows.browserRoute: Dynamic radio controls named mnemocode-decode-missing-way choose one of MissingCodesSearch.ways; their generated radios have no IDs.
rows.refusalMapping: No selected way is an error; impossible fingerprint/checksum combinations or an oversized list are refused; wallet way requires evidence.
rows.progressMapping: Marked-code worker checked/total/found updates and assessed long-work consent.
rows.cancelMapping: Missing-stop terminates the worker; way/evidence edits revise ownership.
rows.outputMapping: Found or none/several verdicts; list outcome is explicitly unverified and does not assert wallet identity.
rows.pendingValidation: Exclusive ways, fingerprint collisions, bounded-list refusal and warning text.

rows.cliSemantics: For marked masked codes with complete dates, unmask by the actual recorded/selected mode and compare each candidate with the wallet.
rows.browserRoute: Wallet way captures dates/evidence; the marked reading's mode overrides host hints and is passed to the worker.
rows.refusalMapping: Missing/invalid dates or wallet evidence are refused; no encoded fingerprint is substituted for original-wallet evidence.
rows.progressMapping: Combined code work reports checked/total/found on the missing status line.
rows.cancelMapping: Worker termination and Decode revision protect the result and captured passphrase.
rows.outputMapping: Filled codes, actual mode/form, dates and decoded original phrase; successful wallet passphrase is handed on with the result.
rows.pendingValidation: Complete-date masked-code recovery, wrong-wallet refusal and original versus encoded fingerprint distinction.

rows.cliSemantics: Jointly recover marked codes and incomplete dates, assess combined work and require identifying evidence where checksum cannot distinguish date choices.
rows.browserRoute: Wallet way passes patterns into DatesAnswer and uses MissingCodesSearch.byWallet; the generated max-candidates control is admitted by MnemoCodeSearchSettings and plan.ask becomes a second-press Search anyway question.
rows.refusalMapping: Wallet way cannot run without evidence; shared date/code hard bounds remain enforced.
rows.progressMapping: Combined plan and checked/total/found updates; consent is retained only for identical captured inputs.
rows.cancelMapping: Missing-stop destroys the worker; input revisions suppress stale combined results.
rows.outputMapping: Filled codes, dates/foundDates and original phrase with wallet factor captured from the request.
rows.pendingValidation: Combined work, required evidence, custom allowance below assessed work, unchanged hard bounds and confirmation revoked by setting edits.

rows.cliSemantics: Distinguish encoded phrases from complete/marked shares; keep the first entered share when routing and transfer only restore-supported settings.
rows.browserRoute: BackupReading.shareKind asks on either; handOverShare/takeHandedOverShares select Restore and prepend the first share without discarding previously entered shares. Routing does not run work. Restore exposes its own max-tries/max-candidates, mode/dates and evidence choices before the separate Restore click; their SearchLimits reach ShareRestore through the worker.
rows.refusalMapping: No ambiguous-kind answer stops Decode; a build without shares explains that it cannot restore shares. Only Restore's applicable controls form its request; an encoded fingerprint or code-job confirmation is not treated as share evidence/consent.
rows.progressMapping: Routing itself is immediate; Restore owns any subsequent repair progress.
rows.cancelMapping: First-share input dispatch revises Restore's own confirmation/result ownership; its request snapshot includes share limits. Decode's marked-code block hides on input/kind changes and its separate job's confirmation is never transferred.
rows.outputMapping: First share retained, route explanation and visible Restore settings, followed by a separate user-started operation. CLI accepted-argument filtering is adapted to sequential browser settings; no flag-copy or confirmation-copy requirement is invented.
rows.pendingValidation: Complete/marked/ambiguous routing, first-share retention, visible allowance choice before Restore, distinct code/share consent, allowance edits revoking confirmation and build-without-shares explanation.

rows.cliSemantics: Recover one or several unknown words, including partial-letter marks; filter exact checksums and retain stable candidate numbers before wallet comparison.
rows.browserRoute: Forgotten builds a words request of kind unknown-words; the worker uses MnemoCodeSearches.words and the vendored WordCandidateSearch.
rows.refusalMapping: Wrong words/counts and excessive combinations are refused by the shared owner; encoded forms get Decode guidance.
rows.progressMapping: Combinations/checksum expectation before starting, checked/found/matched during the worker job.
rows.cancelMapping: Forgotten-stop terminates the worker; input edits drop the result and wipe retained list bytes.
rows.outputMapping: Stable numbered rows with filled words and optional wallet path, selected phrase/fingerprint/Use and optional protected list.
rows.pendingValidation: Multiword/partial-letter known answers, exact candidate numbering and checking beyond the visible subset.

rows.cliSemantics: Insert one missing word at every possible position, preserving given-word order and deduplicating repeated candidate phrases; incompatible with the legacy replacement action.
rows.browserRoute: Mutually exclusive where radios choose missing-word versus places or legacy; the words worker uses the same WordCandidateSearch kind.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared input-length/count/combination rules; missing and legacy cannot be selected simultaneously in the radio group.
rows.progressMapping: Expected combinations before starting and worker checked/found/matched updates.
rows.cancelMapping: Forgotten-stop and input revision as for ordinary word search.
rows.outputMapping: Stable candidate number plus insertion position/new word, selected phrase and optional list; supplied-word order comes from the owner.
rows.pendingValidation: Each insertion position, repeated-word deduplication and refusal of malformed missing-word inputs.

rows.cliSemantics: List checksum-valid final-word replacements of an exact stored legacy phrase, mark the entropy-preserving row and optionally compare those replacements with wallet evidence; refuse candidate-list output.
rows.browserRoute: Legacy without wallet evidence uses the bounded local replacement display. With evidence the visible wallet controls build a legacy-replacements worker request and call MnemoCodeSearches.#legacy; list output remains disabled.
sharedOwnerCalls: renderCandidates with Stored replacement label and LEGACY_REPLACEMENTS_NOTE
rows.refusalMapping: Exact-input/mark refusals and no-list restriction match the shared operation; the browser replacement warning does not make these original-wallet candidates.
rows.progressMapping: Without evidence a bounded local list; with evidence checked/found/matched worker progress.
rows.cancelMapping: Wallet comparison uses Forgotten-stop and job revision; the immediate list clears on edits.
rows.outputMapping: Word/word-number/checksum/preserved marker and replacement phrases, plus wallet match/path where requested. An explicit warning says evidence compares stored replacements, not original legacy phrases.
rows.pendingValidation: Preserved row, exact replacement family, wallet comparisons/path and prohibition of candidate-list output without relabeling replacements as recovered originals.

rows.cliSemantics: Recover date digits, alternatives separated by | and whole dates, enforcing calendar, repeated-pattern, phrase-specific count and hard combination limits.
rows.browserRoute: Forgotten uses mnemoCodeCodes with the admitted word count and passes date patterns into MnemoCodeSearches.dates; marked-code wallet recovery accepts the same date syntax.
rows.refusalMapping: Calendar/pattern/date-count/hard-work refusals are shared; Direct is not a date-search mode.
rows.progressMapping: Date combination count while typing and measured time/checked/found/matched updates during search.
rows.cancelMapping: Forgotten-stop terminates the worker; edited patterns revoke results and consent.
rows.outputMapping: Dates associated with each original phrase, numbering and optional wallet path/list; masked code fingerprint remains separate.
rows.pendingValidation: Leap/calendar limits, alternatives, repeated patterns, whole-date marks and phrase-specific maximum dates.

rows.cliSemantics: recover-date requires at least one incomplete date; checksum-preserving modes require wallet evidence, while legacy checksum filtering may enumerate without it.
rows.browserRoute: ForgottenDates.request captures patterns and wallet evidence; MnemoCodeSearches.dates parses them and calls the shared DatesAnswer.assertIncomplete before constructing DateSearch.
rows.refusalMapping: Missing required wallet evidence and complete dates are refused. The UI hint supplements the adapter's hard shared admission guard.
rows.progressMapping: Complete dates are refused before search progress; legacy incomplete patterns can enumerate without wallet evidence.
rows.cancelMapping: Worker stop/revision remains available for the admitted request.
rows.outputMapping: An incomplete-date refusal or normal numbered recovery results from admitted patterns.
rows.pendingValidation: Complete-date refusal, checksum-preserving evidence requirement and legacy enumeration without evidence.

rows.cliSemantics: Keep immutable hard safety bounds, user consent allowances and retained-result limits distinct; an allowance below assessed work asks or refuses, never truncates the cryptographic search.
rows.browserRoute: Date/marked controls carry maxCandidates; dates separately carry maxShown/progressEvery. Restore/Repair instantiate share settings with the core maximum and send limits.shares/limits.dates through the worker/adapter to ShareRestore. Each share consent snapshot includes its own limits.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared hard bounds remain intact and Search anyway does not widen them. Settings reject retention overrides and irrelevant fields; bounded list-candidates omits consent overrides.
rows.progressMapping: Assessed work/time and search totals are reported; max-results changes display retention rather than search work.
rows.cancelMapping: Each search has a worker Stop button; field edits revoke consent for a different request.
rows.outputMapping: Full assessed search or explicit refusal/consent question; no intentional cryptographic prefix search was found.
rows.pendingValidation: Consent below assessed work separately from hard bounds, complete search after fresh consent, limits edits revoking confirmation, code/share job separation, progress cadence and display/list retention.

rows.cliSemantics: Assess extent/time, yield during long work, report progress, stop on signal/Ctrl+C and recheck cancellation after awaited callbacks before publishing.
rows.browserRoute: MnemoCodeWorkerJob owns progress and Cancel; Cancel terminates the isolated worker rather than firing its neverAborted library signal.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared long-work questions and worker errors reach status; stale outcomes are dropped and list bytes wiped.
rows.progressMapping: Checked/total/found/matched and elapsed/time estimate. The date workflow now exposes mnemocode-forgotten-progress-every and passes it to DateSearch.run; other operations keep their shared host callback cadence.
rows.cancelMapping: Stop destroys the worker/resource and rejects the pending request; revision guards run after worker completion and Decode additionally captures its owner revision.
rows.outputMapping: Only the current terminal result is rendered; stopped/dropped jobs show a stop/drop status and no list publication.
rows.pendingValidation: Cancel before ready, during assessment, after callback/crypto completion and before result publication; confirm worker disposal and no stale Copy/Use/Save.

rows.cliSemantics: Preserve complete counts independently of screen caps, continue wallet checks beyond shown rows and retain every listable requested candidate; bounded list-candidates is a different operation.
rows.browserRoute: Date max-results feeds independently admitted maxShown; word recovery uses shared MAX_SHOWN_CANDIDATES and keeps matches; requested candidate-list retention is separate from shown rows.
rows.refusalMapping: Date maxShown uses the admitted positive-count rule rather than the former word-screen upper cap; full/empty list outcomes are explicit and do not stop counting/checking.
rows.progressMapping: Complete found/matched totals continue beyond shown rows; list overflow leaves result counts intact.
rows.cancelMapping: Search Stop or input revision drops/wipes retained list bytes.
rows.outputMapping: Counts, visible subset and explicit list save. Date output retains only its chosen visible matches on screen; all requested listable matches are separately retained for the list.
rows.pendingValidation: Candidate counts and matching beyond screen caps, list overflow/empty refusal and list numbering versus visible match numbering.

rows.cliSemantics: Compare a Bitcoin single-key address over selected profiles on the selected network; unsupported script or multisignature evidence must be refused.
rows.browserRoute: WalletEvidenceField builds address evidence and checks admission before sending the request; the Bitcoin worker recognition compares via the vendored wallet owner.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared address/network/profile restrictions, including unsupported scripts; absent Bitcoin edition removes these controls rather than interpreting a different coin as Bitcoin.
rows.progressMapping: Each checked candidate contributes to its recovery progress; matched path is retained.
rows.cancelMapping: Selected recovery worker Stop; evidence/profile edits invalidate results.
rows.outputMapping: Matched/not-matched verdict and derivation path in candidate/restore/confirmation results.
rows.pendingValidation: Every selected single-key profile/network, unsupported multisignature/P2WSH refusal and per-edition removal.

rows.cliSemantics: Compare a supported coin address on that coin's standard paths; the address determines type/network and coin-specific restrictions apply, without Bitcoin-only options.
rows.browserRoute: The coin selector is populated from MnemoCodeWalletRecognition.COINS. Full builds use upstream COINS; selective composition admits its Dash/Ethereum subset and swaps the compatible recognition owner.
sharedOwnerCalls: WalletEvidenceCheck.matchAsync or CoinAddressCheck via the coin-only adapter
rows.refusalMapping: A non-admitted coin is refused; network/profile controls are hidden for coin evidence and no Bitcoin-only fields enter its request.
rows.progressMapping: Recovery progress includes local coin checks and matches.
rows.cancelMapping: Recovery worker termination and coin/evidence input revision.
rows.outputMapping: Coin address verdict with matched path; a single admitted coin is named directly instead of showing an unnecessary selector.
rows.pendingValidation: Final admitted COINS versus upstream inventory, each coin's published vectors/exclusions, full build and Dash/selective composition.

rows.cliSemantics: Compare the original wallet's BIP32 master fingerprint with a collision/filter warning; the encoded fingerprint is a separate check of encoded backup codes.
rows.browserRoute: Wallet fingerprint uses the original candidate with its requested BIP39 passphrase. Marked-code encoded way uses codes before unmasking and has a different field.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared fingerprint syntax and collision warnings; no encoded fingerprint is substituted as original-wallet proof.
rows.progressMapping: Recovery checked/found/matched totals; Encode/Decode notes also compute non-passphrase display fingerprints.
rows.cancelMapping: Recovery worker Stop and revision guards; asynchronous legacy display fingerprints are also owner-revoked.
rows.outputMapping: Warning, match/path as applicable, and explicitly original/encoded fingerprint labels with their empty-passphrase display qualification.
rows.pendingValidation: Original versus encoded and nonempty-passphrase recognition, malformed fingerprint refusal and collision warning.

rows.cliSemantics: Compare the complete master extended public key on its network; reject account-placement flags rather than silently interpreting them as a master-key location.
rows.browserRoute: Choosing master-xpub hides placement/scan controls and builds only kind/value/network; no active placement setting is transmitted for this evidence kind.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared extended-key encoding/network validation; CLI explicitly rejects supplied placement flags, while the browser excludes unavailable fields from this operation.
rows.progressMapping: One complete master-key check per candidate; recovery progress owns totals.
rows.cancelMapping: Recovery worker Stop; key kind/value/network edits invalidate prior results.
rows.outputMapping: Master-key match verdict, without claiming an account or address scan path.
rows.pendingValidation: Complete-key equality/network refusal and switching from previously entered placement settings to master evidence.

rows.cliSemantics: Compare an account extended public key at selected account/profile/network; it is account evidence, not an address scan and takes no scan-gap.
rows.browserRoute: Account-xpub carries profiles/location without addresses; the addresses field is hidden and the shared owner compares account paths.
rows.refusalMapping: Invalid account key/profile/network is refused; address count is omitted. Branch/index fields remain part of the common location UI although the account owner uses only account.
rows.progressMapping: Account-key check per candidate, not a consecutive address scan.
rows.cancelMapping: Recovery worker Stop and evidence revisions.
rows.outputMapping: Account-level matched derivation path and verdict.
rows.optionalClarity: The authorized Mnemo owner confirms CLI and browser both pass location.branch/index while account-xpub uses only account. Explaining or hiding unused fields is optional interface clarity, not a missing operation or parity blocker.
rows.pendingValidation: Account-xpub owner semantics match CLI: account-level recognition ignores branch/index. No missing scan was established; actual browser acceptance is unexecuted.

rows.cliSemantics: Compare a compressed public key within the selected receiving/change key range and report the exact matching derivation path.
rows.browserRoute: Compressed-public-key selects located/scanned evidence and passes the bounded address count into the shared check.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared compression/hex/key, range, profile and network validation; normal-index and count boundaries are read from the owner.
rows.progressMapping: Recovery candidate totals include the bounded key scan per candidate.
rows.cancelMapping: Recovery Stop destroys the worker; placement/count edits invalidate the result.
rows.outputMapping: Matched compressed key path in candidate/restore/confirmation results.
rows.pendingValidation: First/last permitted index, multiple-address match, bad compression/hex and matched-path fidelity.

rows.cliSemantics: Read private WIF evidence from a local secret file, validate network/compression and compare locally; never treat it as watch-only material.
rows.browserRoute: WIF key kind changes the shared key input to password, shows a spend-authority warning and clears it before switching to a public-key kind. WalletEvidenceField installs a generated Open a text file action beside the key with preserveWhitespace:false; file ends are trimmed before local worker recognition.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared WIF encoding/network/compression validation and bounded UTF-8 admission with fixed secret-free errors. The (literal || input) guard refuses DOM normalization of any input, including WIF with preserveWhitespace:false; it does not silently strip internal CR/LF. No watch-only/provider route is used.
rows.progressMapping: Recovery progress includes the local bounded key scan.
rows.cancelMapping: Recovery worker Stop and field revisions; changing away from WIF wipes the DOM field value.
rows.outputMapping: Match/path only, with no WIF echo in the result.
rows.pendingValidation: Source challenge confirms the (literal || input) DOM-equality guard also refuses sanitized malformed key text when preserveWhitespace is false. Exact refusal and file boundaries remain subject to real-browser acceptance.

rows.cliSemantics: Apply account/branch/start index, consecutive-address allowance and BIP39 passphrase consistently; select one evidence kind and reject unused CLI placement settings.
rows.browserRoute: Exactly one wallet radio selects the evidence shape; shared place/count parsers feed that shape and the raw password value accompanies it. A generated Open a text file action beside the passphrase uses stripFinalLineBreak:true, literal whitespace and BOM preservation. Master/coin/account-specific inactive fields are hidden or omitted. Concealed textareas use the common exact-value owner: imported CR/CRLF remain canonical even when presented as LF; real edits, Clear and pagehide discard that capture.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared normal-index/count and evidence validation; none/no selected evidence is handled separately. Supported BIP39 file passwords with internal CR/LF are currently host-refused by the single-line field, a confirmed parity gap rather than shared unsupported input. Browser does not reproduce CLI argument-presence errors for inactive fields.
rows.progressMapping: Recovery progress reflects complete candidate checks over the requested range.
rows.cancelMapping: Evidence/passphrase/range edits invalidate the captured request and results.
rows.outputMapping: Matched path and explicitly captured passphrase at phrase handoff/list construction; display fingerprints remain qualified as empty-passphrase where appropriate.
rows.fixStatus: pending-fix-handoff; Carson owns the existing field fix, with no agent runtime acceptance
rows.pendingValidation: Parent text-file and all-instance binding fixtures passed, including normalized textarea presentation, exact imported factor, edit/clear/pagehide and Show/Hide. Actual browser file and reveal acceptance remains unexecuted.

rows.cliSemantics: Create/read integrity-protected MNCL lists with entropy, list/record passphrase fields, stable numbering, Padme padding and admission bounds; empty or oversized lists are not published.
rows.browserRoute: Recovery workers use the shared writer; a generated Save candidate list action downloads its bytes. Scanner opens a protected list through the shared decoder and maps record order to candidate numbers.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared size/integrity/passphrase/record validation; empty/full list outcomes have explicit UI messages and no file.
rows.progressMapping: Search totals continue independently of list retention; Scanner shows opening status and admitted record count.
rows.cancelMapping: Search Stop/dropped outcomes wipe list buffers; Scanner Remove/Clear/replacement generation drops late opened lists and wipes entropy.
rows.outputMapping: candidates.age or explicitly consented candidates.mncl download; stable record numbers feed Scanner batch inputs. Explicit plaintext reading is mapped at P34.
rows.pendingValidation: Exact format/integrity/padding boundaries, overflow/empty refusal, every passphrase storage mode and number correspondence.

rows.cliSemantics: Settle candidate-list protection before long work: Scanner age recipient, separate list passphrase or explicit plaintext consent; validate options and wipe working buffers.
rows.browserRoute: CandidateListField installs generated Open a text file actions beside recipient, passphrase and confirmation inputs, with normalize delegated to parseRecipient or parseListPassphrase. request requires one protection choice or advanced plaintext confirmation; adapters construct protectionFor/ListWriter before long search. Concealed textareas use the common exact-value owner: imported CR/CRLF remain canonical even when presented as LF; real edits, Clear and pagehide discard that capture.
rows.refusalMapping: No encryption choice, unequal passphrases, malformed recipient and shared passphrase/bounds errors are refused before work; plaintext needs an explicit warning acknowledgment. A supported list passphrase with internal CR/LF is currently refused by the single-line browser import, not by parseListPassphrase.
rows.progressMapping: Recovery progress starts only after writer/protection admission; protection errors remain input errors.
rows.cancelMapping: Worker Stop discards work; retained/list bytes are wiped on dropped result, input change or Save.
rows.outputMapping: One protected/explicitly plaintext list, with description and download-folder/cloud synchronization warning.
rows.fixStatus: pending-fix-handoff; scoped reuse of Carson's existing field fix, with no agent runtime acceptance
rows.pendingValidation: Parent text-file and all-instance binding fixtures passed, including normalized textarea presentation, exact imported factor, edit/clear/pagehide and Show/Hide. Actual browser file and reveal acceptance remains unexecuted.

rows.cliSemantics: Use public APIs for bounded plaintext/encrypted candidate-file admission and recipient/passphrase decryption. CANDIDATES.md requires reader permission for plaintext import; no standalone CLI decrypt command exists.
rows.browserRoute: Unchecked plaintext consent uses bounded encrypted-header inspection and age X25519/scrypt opening. Checking the explicit unencrypted recovery-material acknowledgment selects inspectPlaintext/openPlaintext, then the same owned MNCL parser/lifecycle.
rows.refusalMapping: Size/header changes, foreign key/file errors and malformed MNCL are owner refusals. openPlaintext requires consent and plaintext never becomes an automatic fallback after encrypted opening fails.
rows.progressMapping: Opening status; no decryption progress percentage.
rows.cancelMapping: Remove/Clear/replacement increment a generation and prevent retaining late plaintext; scrypt itself is not forcibly cancelled by this panel.
rows.outputMapping: Candidate count/passphrase-storage facts and Scanner batch inputs, never a bulk visible phrase dump or automatic public scan.
rows.policyDecision: Plaintext import is reader-controlled, not an automatic demand to expose every library API. CANDIDATES.md:87/:103 specifies reader permission. The parent's new explicit checkbox exercises that permission; encrypted import remains the default. This matrix did not authorize or implement a policy change.
rows.pendingValidation: New plaintext consent/refusal and admission tests are pending with the parent; check oversized prefix/body, encrypted failure without fallback, malformed secret-free errors and removal/replacement races.

rows.cliSemantics: Decode an old backup, show phrase/fingerprint and require recognition or successful wallet comparison before releasing it to new Encode; checksum alone is not consent and recognition/evidence are alternate confirmation ways.
rows.browserRoute: Re-encode reads an owned snapshot into MnemoCodeReEncoding; recognition or a current worker match enables Continue, which calls confirmedPhrase before linking the source to Encode.
rows.refusalMapping: Invalid reading/checksum or unconfirmed phrase cannot continue; wallet mismatch does not confirm; warning and match path/filter warning are displayed.
rows.progressMapping: Read is bounded; wallet worker exposes a checking status and Cancel rather than a search percentage.
rows.cancelMapping: Cancel terminates the confirmation worker; old-backup or wallet-factor edits reset confirmation, invalidate pending results and revoke the linked capability.
rows.outputMapping: Concealed old phrase/fingerprint and explicit confirmation, then a revocable source reference used by normal Encode; no clipboard round trip.
rows.pendingValidation: Checksum-only refusal, recognition/match exclusivity, mismatch and cancellation races, factor edits and post-confirmation source revocation.

rows.cliSemantics: For a lossy legacy final-word replacement backup, require the original remembered last word to select one original; still require the independent re-encoding confirmation.
rows.browserRoute: The concealed last-word field is frozen into the old-backup input; ReEncoding.of selects through #withLastWord but confirmedPhrase remains unavailable until confirmation.
rows.refusalMapping: Missing/nonmatching remembered last word is refused without echoing it; word selection is not confirmation and does not invoke the unrelated replacement-list workflow.
rows.progressMapping: Bounded candidate-family selection, then optional wallet checking status.
rows.cancelMapping: Last-word/input edits clear the session/confirmation; wallet Stop is separate.
rows.outputMapping: One original phrase/fingerprint pending recognition or wallet match, then the same guarded Encode handoff.
rows.pendingValidation: Every lossy legacy family, missing/wrong remembered word, and proof that selecting a word never bypasses confirmation.

rows.cliSemantics: After confirmation use normal Encode for all new modes/dates/forms, optional legacy replacement, SSKR and applicable record/QR/card/image/heir/backup-check outputs; preserve the old-backup warning and owned result.
rows.browserRoute: Continue links the confirmed phrase to the existing MnemoCode source owner, so Encode, Split and Cards read the same capability and choose new settings independently of the old backup.
rows.refusalMapping: No confirmed source means no handoff; each downstream capability still refuses unsupported legacy/share/card operations.
rows.progressMapping: The downstream operation owns its status/progress, rather than reusing confirmation progress.
rows.cancelMapping: Re-encode input/evidence revisions revoke the linked capability; Split captures inputs/readiness before its await. The final shared QrPngExport.save rechecks the sensitive result, reveal and readiness predicate after toBlob; createQrAction also revokes publication on detachment and pagehide (P52/P59).
rows.outputMapping: Normal Encode record, JSON, standalone raw-payload QR/PNG, shares and supported documents, with the warning that a new backup does not revoke the old one. P52 establishes exact standalone QR payload equivalence.
gaps: Integrated real-browser QR download and lifetime acceptance remains unexecuted. The P52/P59 code handoff is complete and its passive delayed-publication fixtures passed; this is an acceptance gap, not pending source work or a separate QR workflow.
rows.pendingValidation: The final shared QrPngExport/renderSensitiveShares owner and passive delayed-publication fixtures cover the confirmed P52/P59 defect. Actual browser QR download and lifetime acceptance remain unexecuted.

rows.cliSemantics: Split every supported BIP39 length with validated threshold/count and host randomness; generation is one group rather than a grouped-policy editor.
rows.browserRoute: Preset/custom sets use ShareSetChoice; Split snapshots source/settings and calls MnemoCodeShares with the pinned SSKR platform and fillSecureRandom. Current-input/readiness checks precede all post-await publication.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared phrase/threshold/count and split-capability checks; there is no grouped generation claim. The set check verifies the generated shares reconstruct the held phrase.
rows.progressMapping: A split status after completion; no long-search progress or separate split Cancel control.
rows.cancelMapping: Input/source/settings changes, page lifetime and lost readiness revise the capture and clear held shares. A late split result returns without publishing; result actions also check the captured ownership. No dedicated bounded-split Stop is offered.
rows.outputMapping: Concealed shares, optional whole-phrase representation, original/encoded fingerprint distinction, text download, card handoff and share-backup check.
rows.pendingValidation: All supported lengths, threshold/count boundaries, checked randomness/platform and source-change race during split.

rows.cliSemantics: Read/write UR, Bytewords and mirrored word-number/Unicode/RGB/Color Unicode share transports; enforce CRC, CBOR tag, lengths, versions and framing, keeping Bytewords distinct from BIP39 words.
rows.browserRoute: Split populates named transport options; Restore parses each supplied share; Repair keeps its form or uses the requested common form.
rows.refusalMapping: Transport/CRC/tag/version/framing refusals are owner results, not generic text acceptance; share-word hints use SHARE_WORD_HINTS.
rows.progressMapping: Restore/repair worker progress when marked elements require search.
rows.cancelMapping: Restore/repair Stop and revisions; Split checks its input/readiness capture after its await and guards generated actions.
rows.outputMapping: Exact requested transport, group/member facts in shared reports and joined/apart mirrored element displays.
rows.pendingValidation: Every named transport, independent known records and CRC/tag/length/version/framing negatives.

rows.cliSemantics: Restore imported grouped policies with group/member thresholds, set IDs, duplicates/conflicts and unused-share notes; preserve group/member references.
rows.browserRoute: Typed/file/multiple QR shares reach ShareInput and ShareRestore through the worker. The one-group restriction applies to local generation/card notes, not this restoration owner.
rows.refusalMapping: Owner quorum/set conflicts and unsupported records are explicit trouble outcomes; duplicate and unused-share notes are retained.
rows.progressMapping: Grouped restoration/marked repair assessment and worker checked/total status.
rows.cancelMapping: Restore-stop destroys the worker; new share input invalidates the result and candidate list.
rows.outputMapping: Original phrase/fingerprint, per-share repairs and shared topology/unused-share notes, with explicit Deriver handoff.
rows.pendingValidation: Independent grouped-policy records, quorum across groups, conflicting members, duplicates and unused-share reference fidelity.

rows.cliSemantics: Split/restore only share-capable modes; Direct shares hold the phrase, Seedshift shares hold the masked phrase and require the dates to recover the wallet; legacy split is unsupported in both hosts.
rows.browserRoute: Split asks Masking.capabilities.split; Restore offers Direct/Seedshift and the shared ShareUnmasking owner applies known or searched dates.
rows.refusalMapping: Legacy split is explicitly refused with a user-facing Direct/Seedshift explanation; wrong/missing dates or missing evidence for searched checksum-preserving dates are shared refusals.
rows.progressMapping: Immediate split status or restoration/date-search worker progress.
rows.cancelMapping: Restore Stop; bounded Split has no dedicated Stop, but revisions suppress late publication and result actions.
rows.outputMapping: Held masked phrase versus original phrase/fingerprints are distinguished; dates are not embedded in the shares.
sharedUnsupportedCases: Splitting seedshift-legacy or seedshift-legacy-valid is unsupported by both the upstream capability owner and browser.
rows.pendingValidation: Legacy split refusal, correct/wrong/missing dates, masked-versus-original output and no stored dates.

rows.cliSemantics: Repair one marked share using transport constraints and CRC, with whole/partial marks, ambiguity handling and bounded solution spaces.
rows.browserRoute: Forgotten share repair sends one or more marked inputs to MnemoCodeShares.repair; below quorum and without wallet evidence the shared owner attempts independent uniquely settled repairs.
rows.refusalMapping: Malformed/oversized marked spaces, no settled share and representation ambiguity are owner messages; an ambiguous variant does not become a settled exported share.
rows.progressMapping: Assessment lines, possible long-search consent and worker checked/total status.
rows.cancelMapping: Share repair Stop destroys the worker; changed marks/form/evidence invalidate the result.
rows.outputMapping: Filled-element/guess table, correction notes and only settled rewritten shares; ambiguous alternatives are display-only variants.
rows.pendingValidation: One-share CRC known answers, whole/partial marks, multiple readings, no-solution and hard-space refusals.

rows.cliSemantics: Jointly assess/search marked shares using digest/quorum, unmask dates and compare the original wallet; preserve certainty, guesses and unused-share explanations.
rows.browserRoute: Share worker binds the pinned platform and wallet recognition, then forwards the owning Restore/Repair controls' SearchLimits to the same ShareRestore planner/run through MnemoCodeShares.
rows.refusalMapping: Quorum/digest/date/wallet refusals and guess/unused-share notes remain owner outcomes. Typed allowance bounds are admitted before work; core searchDecision requests fresh consent where assessed work exceeds those allowances.
rows.progressMapping: Assessment/consent lines and combined checked/total progress; no claim that certainty comes from a visible successful checksum alone.
rows.cancelMapping: Restore/repair Stop destroys the worker; request edits revoke publication and retained list bytes.
rows.outputMapping: Original phrases or rewritten shares, per-element repairs/guess markers, dates, wallet paths and unused-share notes.
rows.pendingValidation: Digest/quorum known answers, masked wallet recognition, uncertainty/unused-share fidelity, allowance bounds and fresh consent for the exact share request.

rows.cliSemantics: Display ambiguous per-share or multiple-set repair variants without saving a chosen variant; actual next actions are retype/add shares or finish, with wallet evidence able to settle complete sets.
rows.browserRoute: A variants outcome renders every alternative and returns before #offerShares, so no variant is placed in latestShares or offered as a text/card file. Retyping/adding shares or evidence starts another repair.
rows.refusalMapping: Unsettled outcomes retain a warning and no selected/saved variant; no unsupported explicit variant-selection action is invented.
rows.progressMapping: Repair assessment/search progress, then a variants warning.
rows.cancelMapping: Repair Stop; edits discard the displayed alternatives and request ownership.
rows.outputMapping: Variant fingerprint, filled-element guesses and concealed share text. Generated Copy actions can copy displayed text, but there is no file/card save or selection for a variant.
rows.pendingValidation: Multiple per-share/set variants, no latestShares/text-file/card publication and parent review of displayed Copy actions versus the CLI's display-only semantics.

rows.cliSemantics: Rewrite complete shares without reconstructing a phrase when no wallet check was requested; below quorum repair only uniquely settled shares. Wallet checks require quorum and Seedshift repair requires evidence.
rows.browserRoute: Repair without a selected wallet uses direct/unknown holding semantics; ShareRestore.rewritesOnly short-circuits complete inputs without reconstruction. A supplied wallet remains in the request on failure.
rows.refusalMapping: Wallet below quorum is refused; Seedshift/evidence refusal remains shared. Browser does not silently retry without evidence: changing the wallet choice is an explicit new request.
rows.progressMapping: Complete rewrite is bounded; marked-share repair reports assessed/search progress.
rows.cancelMapping: Repair Stop and input/evidence revision; no successful partial-wallet check is claimed.
rows.outputMapping: Rewritten shares plus known masked/unknown holding note, with no restored phrase display on this route.
rows.pendingValidation: Complete shares below quorum without reconstruction, uniquely repairable partial inputs and explicit removal of a requested wallet check.

rows.cliSemantics: Re-export settled shares in original forms or one requested common form; omit unsettled shares with notes, save duplicates once and require a common form for mixed-form cards.
rows.browserRoute: Blank form preserves each share's format; a common form goes to ShareExport. Settled results get a generated text Save action and only common-form results are handed to the card owner.
rows.refusalMapping: Unsettled and duplicate notes are shared; mixed formats get explicit common-form card guidance rather than a silent conversion.
rows.progressMapping: Repair progress precedes file/card handoff; card rendering has its own status.
rows.cancelMapping: Repair Stop and edits forget its held shares; card InputRevision rejects stale handoffs/publication.
rows.outputMapping: Unique settled share text file plus requested PDF/image/ZIP cards of the captured common-form records.
rows.pendingValidation: Mixed-form preservation/common conversion, duplicates, omitted unsettled shares and text/card record agreement.

rows.cliSemantics: Print supported Unicode/RGB/Color Unicode shares with imported group/member references; grouped printing must not imply grouped generation. UR, Bytewords and word-number share transports have no cards.
rows.browserRoute: shareFormatHasCards gates the supported transport subset; ShareCardSet.create checks imported topology/references. The revised host shareCardSet metadata adapter retains records without a one-group rejection.
rows.refusalMapping: Unsupported transport card refusal is shared and explained; shared imported-set validation is retained without the former host-only group restriction.
rows.progressMapping: Rendering status for admitted imported groups and layouts.
rows.cancelMapping: Card inputs and latestShares changes invalidate publication; no dedicated render Stop.
rows.outputMapping: Imported grouped/single-group cards retain shared group/member references; keepingAdvice uses shareKeepingNote on the actual records and packaging rather than inventing one-group quorum.
sharedUnsupportedCases: Cards for UR, Bytewords or word-number shares are unsupported by both owners.
rows.pendingValidation: Supported transport subset, imported grouped PDF/ZIP references, topology-based keeping notes and retained one-group generation distinction.

rows.cliSemantics: Resolve whole-share QR, collection or individual-fragment card layout using actual page-size rules; collection forbids business, individual forbids sheet sizes and QR layout permits every size.
rows.browserRoute: Whole-share QR checkbox passes layout=qr; otherwise the shared size rule selects collection for sheets or individual for business cards. The browser prevents contradictory layout/size combinations through those choices.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared layout/size/material-design refusals remain in the renderer; no unsupported collection-at-business or individual-at-sheet operation is invented.
rows.progressMapping: Card rendering status, not share-search progress.
rows.cancelMapping: InputRevision invalidates late card/image publication; rendering has no explicit Stop button.
rows.outputMapping: QR card per share, collection sheet per share or individually packed fragments as resolved by the owner; geometry derives from shared page facts.
sharedUnsupportedCases: Explicit collection/business and individual/sheet combinations are refused by the shared layout rule.
rows.pendingValidation: Every QR/collection/individual size combination, geometry/orientation and resolved packaging.

rows.cliSemantics: Select installed designs by ID or catalogue number; business designs support individual cards, material designs only sheets, including share exports and previews.
rows.browserRoute: The template select is populated from the shared catalogue in order, displaying number/name while transmitting ID. Preview and card/share renderers resolve the same designs.
rows.refusalMapping: Unsupported template and material individual-card requests are refused by shared design rules; invalid combinations need not produce an artifact to establish the refusal path.
rows.progressMapping: Rendering/sample status.
rows.cancelMapping: Template/size edits revise export ownership; no dedicated render Stop.
rows.outputMapping: Selected shared design in PDF/image/ZIP; catalogue labels give the same public numbering as the CLI.
sharedUnsupportedCases: Material-design individual cards are unsupported in both owners.
rows.pendingValidation: Catalogue ID/number equality and material-sheet versus individual-card refusal in phrase, share and preview paths.

rows.cliSemantics: Customize profile, design copy, title, size/orientation and permitted QR settings; invented details and decoys stay stable within the export/session and across its files.
rows.browserRoute: Own-details selects only applicable visible copy fields; captureRender snapshots settings before asynchronous work. The exporter retains CardSession and a per-layout DecoyTail cache until the source is forgotten.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared settings/profile/text limits and design/layout restrictions; share exports omit collection title and individual fragments omit whole-backup QR.
rows.progressMapping: Drawing/rendering status; planned details are not presented as secret recovery evidence.
rows.cancelMapping: Source/settings changes invalidate publication; a new phrase, Clear or pagehide also forgets details/decoys.
rows.outputMapping: Captured profile/copy/title and stable invented details/decoy layout in requested output files; printed note derives from the rendered content.
rows.pendingValidation: All profile/copy fields, hidden-field exclusion, title/QR restrictions and repeated PDF/image exports with stable details/decoys.

rows.cliSemantics: Export collection PDF, individual documents or PNG/JPEG pages using exact shared geometry and document facts, private publication and consistent planned content for multiple outputs.
rows.browserRoute: One selected file format per browser export maps through shared document facts; individual documents are packed in a ZIP and image output uses the browser rasterizer of shared drawing instructions.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared page/design/output facts and one-page admission; unavailable rasterizer is an explicit error. Browser download-folder/cloud consequences are explained.
rows.progressMapping: Rendering status; browser drawing yields before heavy work and image conversion checks current ownership.
rows.cancelMapping: Source/settings/lifetime edits invalidate output; buffers and object URLs are cleared/revoked around publication. There is no dedicated synchronous-render Stop.
rows.outputMapping: PDF/PNG/JPEG download or ZIP of named individual/share files. CLI simultaneous outputs become separate browser exports sharing the retained session and planned decoys.
rows.pendingValidation: Exact geometry/pages/names, transparency versus white corners, consistent repeated PDF/image content and private/stale publication boundaries.

rows.cliSemantics: Export standalone QR of the encoded backup's raw representation text, or the whole share-sheet payload and companion PNG; individual printed fragments never receive a full-share QR. Read local PNG QR through bounded admission. CLI --qr uses backup.text(), not backup.record().
rows.browserRoute: encode-mnemocode -> Encode.#show -> renderSensitiveShares([result.payload]) -> generated QR button (.qr-trigger) -> popup Save as PNG (.payment-qr-save). result.payload is backup.text(), for every selected representation and independently of cards. Supported card exports separately expose file.qrCodes; import actions come from installFieldImports.
rows.refusalMapping: Whole-share QR is absent on fragments and unsupported transport cards are refused; PNG admission belongs to the local QR import helper.
rows.progressMapping: QR draws on popup opening; Save as PNG reports Saving/Saved/failure. Card drawing and PNG import have their own status; standalone Encode QR needs no card job.
rows.cancelMapping: QR popup closes on Close/Escape and result replacement removes controls, but those actions do not cancel an already awaited toBlob continuation. saveQrPng currently publishes without rechecking sensitive-result ownership/readiness after that await. Card/import revisions do not by themselves guard this separate PNG callback. PNG publication rechecks ownership after toBlob; Clear/edit, detached card, concealment, gate loss and pagehide revoke it. Canvas and matrix state are cleared in finally.
rows.outputMapping: Standalone raw-payload PNG for all forms, identical in semantic text to CLI --qr; separate MNC1 Save record includes mode/form. Sheet/whole-share PNG and fragment exclusion follow shared packaging facts. Neither host's standalone --qr embeds an MNC1 envelope.
rows.fixStatus: pending-fix-handoff; parent owns payment-qr.ts and the sensitive-render predicate, with no agent runtime acceptance

sourceIdentity.purpose: Retained point-in-time bytes for the earlier QR payload/route challenge, not final lifecycle-fix bytes or test/build/artifact evidence. Parent owns the new payment-qr/predicate fix and final source pin; these historical inspection hashes must not be credited to that pending fix.

rows.pendingValidation: Parent delayed-canvas and sensitive-action fixtures passed within the recorded partial batch. Actual browser canvas/download/lifecycle acceptance remains unexecuted; no new standalone QR route was added.

rows.cliSemantics: Generate heir instructions tied to actual mode/form, phrase length, decoys, share policy and packaging; refuse lossy legacy replacement instructions by shared capability.
rows.browserRoute: Heirs snapshots encoded/share choices, mode, number of dates, selected/typed phrase length and generated ShareSetChoice, then renders shared text with a Deriver route. Mirrored share cards obtain their own code count from retained matching split records before decoys.
rows.refusalMapping: Replaced-final-word mode is refused; missing phrase length/dates or invalid share set is an owner/input error. Share-card facts refuse imported/repair records or a stale/nonmatching split. Linked phrase length is selected explicitly without reading a linked secret. Instructions contain no mnemonic or dates.
rows.progressMapping: Drawing/saved status for the public instruction sheet.
rows.cancelMapping: InputRevision watches sheet/Encode/source/Split settings, latestShares, source events, readiness and page lifetime. A post-await current check suppresses stale PDF publication and buffers are wiped. No dedicated render Stop.
rows.outputMapping: A5/A6 instruction PDF, kept separately from the secret backup, with browser route and current chosen backup facts.
sharedUnsupportedCases: Heir instructions for seedshift-legacy-valid are unsupported by the shared capability owner.
rows.pendingValidation: Exact instruction facts versus actually kept files, linked-source length, decoy/read-length guidance, packaging and lossy-mode refusal.

rows.cliSemantics: Read back the backup actually kept, compare it with the original, guide corrections and certify restoration only after matching; share checks honor quorum and retained packaging/codes.
rows.browserRoute: Encode and Split offer an EncodedBackupCheck or ShareBackupCheck tied to the generated result. The person retypes kept backup data and dates; a repeated check follows corrections.
rows.refusalMapping: Unusable/lossy-mode checks are not offered; unreadable/differs/unchecked verdicts and correction notes are not presented as restores.
rows.progressMapping: Bounded asynchronous verdict; no search-progress or separate check Stop.
rows.cancelMapping: Check revision changes on typed input, a new press or an offered result and suppresses late verdicts; new Encode/Split state clears the check.
rows.outputMapping: Only restores gets success styling; shared notes identify code/date/share corrections without disclosing the original phrase.
rows.pendingValidation: Actually printed decoy tails, wrong form/mode/dates, share quorum/unused packaging and delayed verdict after an input or source edit.

rows.cliSemantics: Display restored original phrases/fingerprints, found dates and repair notes; masked backup and encoded fingerprint stay distinct, and every requested listable match is retained for Scanner export.
rows.browserRoute: Restore renders every returned phrase with its own repairs/dates/matchedAt and original fingerprint; held/masked backup is a separate concealed display. ListWriter receives restored.listed, not merely the displayed phrases.
rows.refusalMapping: Shared no-match/quorum/date/list refusals and unverified Seedshift warnings are retained; visible phrase count is not assumed to equal all date matches.
rows.progressMapping: Restore/date-search checked/total and elapsed status, plus final displayed phrase count and shared notes.
rows.cancelMapping: Restore-stop destroys worker state; edits drop outcomes and wipe retained list bytes.
rows.outputMapping: Original phrase with its captured passphrase for Deriver Use, dates/repairs/holding facts and protected candidate-list download with numbering explanation.
rows.pendingValidation: More listable matches than the visible cap, exact phrase/list numbering, original versus held fingerprints, passphrase handoff and restored list retention after share allowance consent.

rows.cliSemantics: List installed templates or preview one/every design with a public sample at any supported length; list-only mode processes no secret and separate previews obey design restrictions.
rows.browserRoute: The public template dropdown lists the catalogue; Save sample cards calls captureRender(true) without reading the mnemonic and delegates to shared CardPreview for one/all designs.
rows.refusalMapping: All-design separate previews and material individual cards are refused by the shared design selection rules; listing the select does not launch a render or process a secret.
rows.progressMapping: Drawing sample cards status and heavy-job admission.
rows.cancelMapping: Settings/revision guards suppress stale sample exports; no dedicated render Stop.
rows.outputMapping: One/every design PDF/image or ZIP of separate public-sample cards; public catalogue selection replaces CLI printed --list output.
rows.pendingValidation: Empty-secret public preview, every supported length/design, list-only no-render behavior and all/material separate-card refusals.

rows.cliSemantics: Look up an English word, its human word number or Unicode code and export the complete public mapping; table index is not a wallet derivation index.
rows.browserRoute: Word table radio/value and Enter/button lookups call wordTableRow; Save the whole table calls wordTableText and text download without a phrase input.
rows.refusalMapping: Out-of-range word number, invalid word and Unicode code are shared lookup errors; hints appear only for English-word lookup.
rows.progressMapping: Immediate public lookup/text generation; no search progress.
rows.cancelMapping: No long operation; changing lookup kind clears the result.
rows.outputMapping: Word number/English/Unicode row and complete TSV download; the input is explicitly a 1-based human number.
rows.pendingValidation: Dictionary endpoints, all lookup forms/refusals and exact full mapping versus the upstream owner.

rows.cliSemantics: Run quick startup known answers before secret processing/feature activation and full enabled-feature plus host-adapter checks on self-test; browser composition must provide equivalent feature checks and host services.
rows.browserRoute: The startup recovery composition includes runMnemoCodeSelfTest/core feature answers; RecoveryWorkspace readiness gates primary controls and secret operations. The MnemoCode button/full-page test use MnemoCodeSelfTestRun with optional share/card/heir additions.
rows.refusalMapping: Startup/full-test failure disables the recovery job gate and reports failure; excluded features should carry no corresponding checks. Native OS/file protection checks are not asserted to execute in a browser.
rows.progressMapping: Full test reports rows/durations/public vectors/round trips from the owner; no result counts have been recomputed for this matrix.
rows.cancelMapping: No dedicated self-test Cancel; heavy-job admission and failure gate own activation. Public checks process no user's secret.
rows.outputMapping: Known-answer failures keep controls closed; button/full-page results identify only the checks of installed features and browser adapters.
gaps: The source composition and readiness chain are present, but final generated artifacts, startup-failure controls, selected-edition pruning and browser host services have no executed real-browser acceptance here. Node execution cannot establish their browser behavior; parent acceptance must provide it.
rows.pendingValidation: Parent real-browser checks for injected known-answer failure before every secret action, full enabled-feature tests, browser host services and both admitted editions. Node checks do not establish browser equivalence; no agent runtime.

rows.cliSemantics: Explicitly hand confirmed/recovered phrases, protected candidate lists, records, share transports and documents to host destinations while preserving consent, result ownership and cancellation boundaries.
rows.browserRoute: Generated Copy/Use/Save actions publish only on user clicks; confirmed Re-encode uses an in-memory capability, candidates download for separate Scanner import and cards snapshot their input/result owner before publication.
rows.refusalMapping: Unconfirmed phrase handoff is refused; Scanner import does not start a public scan and protected card/Decode outcomes have guards. An already running sensitive QR PNG export still lacks refusal of late publication after Clear/readiness loss.
rows.progressMapping: Each owning conversion/search/render/import reports its own work; downloads are explicit final actions.
rows.cancelMapping: Search Stop, card/Decode/confirmation/share/heir revisions and list wipes guard their own paths. Split checks current inputs/readiness after its await. The separate QR toBlob callback can still resume and download after its sensitive owner was cleared or lost readiness (P52). PNG publication rechecks ownership after toBlob; Clear/edit, detached card, concealment, gate loss and pagehide revoke it. Canvas and matrix state are cleared in finally.
rows.outputMapping: Explicit Deriver Use, text/age/MNCL/document downloads and separate Scanner import; no direct secret network transmission from MnemoCode recovery is implied.
rows.fixStatus: pending-fix-handoff; the same parent-owned QR lifecycle correction as P52, with no agent runtime acceptance
rows.pendingValidation: Parent delayed-canvas and sensitive-action fixtures passed within the recorded partial batch. Actual browser canvas/download/lifecycle acceptance remains unexecuted; no new standalone QR route was added.

rows.cliSemantics: Expose command help, named topics, version and no-command menu workflows without processing secrets; supported operations must not disappear behind feature menus or capability gates.
rows.browserRoute: Recovery/operation tab buttons use data attributes/aria-controls rather than stable IDs; contextual mode/form popovers and public template/sample/word-table paths adapt menu/help workflows. MnemoCode version appears in result metadata.
rows.refusalMapping: Feature admission removes unavailable components and relevant explanations identify shared unsupported operations. Contextual UI prose is host-owned; it is not automatically the complete CLI command/topic help registry.
rows.progressMapping: Help/menu navigation is immediate and should start no secret processing.
rows.cancelMapping: No job to cancel when reading help; navigation must not revive stale result actions.
rows.outputMapping: Contextual help and operation navigation. No standalone pre-secret MnemoCode version action or complete command/topic-help mapping was identified from this source trace.
gaps: Parent must compare named modes/formats/cards topics and all supported command workflows with browser help; presence of tabs/popovers alone is insufficient.
MNEMOCODE_VERSION is read in generated result metadata; a pre-secret version display needs a concrete reachable source/artifact reference before this obligation is accepted.
rows.pendingValidation: Parent real-browser acceptance of public help/version access before any phrase read, named-topic semantics and admitted menu/operation reachability. Source tabs/popovers and Node success are insufficient; no agent runtime.
